-- What a client importing `Spec.go_etcd_io.bbolt.ApiS` sees of it (generated by etc/gen-interface.py; do not edit).
-- Every declaration also takes the ambient section variables (left out below): the Go semantics
-- (`ext`, `ffi`, `go_gctx`, `sem`, the package's `Assumptions`), `GF`, `hG`, `StorageModel GF`, `AllG GF`.

def bbolt.nameHolds [ExtSemantics Fs.fsExt] [Fs.FsSemOk] [HasExt Fs.fsExt] (h : Fs.NamesH) (b :
    GoString) (D : bbolt.Data) : IProp GF :=
  iprop((∃ i, ⌜h.cur !! b = some (Fs.Node.file i)⌝ ∗ bbolt.fileHoldsM i D) ∨ ⌜h.cur !! b = none ∧ D = ∅⌝)

theorem bbolt.nameHolds_new [ExtSemantics Fs.fsExt] [Fs.FsSemOk] [HasExt Fs.fsExt] (h : Fs.NamesH)
    (b : GoString) (i : Fs.Ino) (hb : h.cur !! b = some (Fs.Node.file i)) : Fs.osMeta i (DFrac.own
    1) Fs.newMeta ⊢ bbolt.nameHolds h b ∅
